notes.title: Major Demo Update & Tiny Teams
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are very excited to announce that Temporal Titans is taking part in the Tiny Teams festival. To celebrate, the demo for the game has been updated with plenty of new content and mechanics. 



The Tiny Teams festival will be running from August 7 to August 14. You can check out all the other great games included in the event by clicking the button below. Thanks to the Yogscast team for organizing the event!

Tiny Teams 2025 Event Page 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108428/0837f71ee7d57c84ef533bcce3da53f0f86315d3.jpg"]



If you enjoy the demo, you can support us by wishlisting the game! And if you'd like to support further, you can leave your feedback on the Steam Discussions forum. 



[dynamiclink href="steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037800/Temporal_Titans/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget"][/dynamiclink]
Demo Update

New Content
New Zone - Northwoods

New Boss - Hive Titan

New Enemy Type - Anchor

3 New Levels - Canyon, District, Pine Valley (one level per zone)

Flying Enemies - 3 types of enemies, following their own lane

New Equipments - Explosive Accelerant, Drive Coils, Melee Capacitors, Ballistic Acid

New Weapons - Ion beam & Rail Gun

Tech Upgrades - Global upgrades to turrets and other features


Changes
Each level now has additional lanes for more variety

Elevation now grants increased attack and damage (Insert high ground joke here)

Mechs can now have up to 7 equip/weapon slots

Mechs are now slowed by enemy attacks

Pilots now have unique stat boots

Pilots can now be “trained” for a fee to upgrade their stats

Pilots now get heavily debuffed on failing a mission or injury

Platforms can now be built on 4 small tiles to "create" a large tile

Rescue mission type re-added


QoL
Options menu now available

You can select multiple different language options now

Loading screens now have helpful tips

Numerous bug fixes

notes.title: Updated Demo | Best Design Nomination at Taipei Game Show
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108428/359c6d32d3afd4baa46b1b520123157def58ed6d.png

Demo update is live!
Temporal Titans has been nominated for Best Design at the Taipei Game Show Indie Game Awards, and in honor of the nomination, a new update to the demo is live now! Check out all the great games taking part in the event by clicking here!

You can leave your feedback about the demo on the Steam Discussions forum.


Changelog

Mission Types

 Salvage Mission: Power Ups are hidden in various buildings.  Demolish buildings and collect them all to get the full rewards for the mission.
 Rescue Mission: Survivors will flee from buildings periodically.  You are provided with a special "bunker" support asset that can hold 4 survivors.  Build a bunker and survivors will run to it.  But both survivors and bunkers can be killed if attacked.  Survivors will attack from inside the bunker.
 Titan Sighted: Standard mission with a Titan at the end.


Mech Upgrades and Power-ups

 Mech weapons are now only upgradable via weapon upgrade power-ups, which appear as blue boxes.
 The other power-up is a Gunner Drone that follows the mech and attacks nearby enemies for light damage.
 More power-ups will be added as development continues.


Enemies and Mission Scaling

 New enemies appear depending on the challenge rating of a level.  
 The level of each zone determines what rating of levels becomes available.
 As zones level up, resistant enemies and special enemy types will also appear (specific to each zone).


New Enemies

 Broodmother: Lays eggs that spawn swarms of small enemies
 Stinger: Fires a projectile at nearby targets when killed
 Armored Raptid: New visuals for armored enemy


New Assets

 Chem Factory:  Adds chemical damage to explosive weapons (stacks with other factories).


Damage System Changes

 Elemental damage now causes "buildup" which can apply status effects associated with that element.

 Repeated or high amounts of fire damage will "ignite" an enemy, burning them for extra damage for a short duration.
 Repeated or high amounts of chemical damage will "poison" an enemy, damaging them a small amount over a long duration.
 Repeated or high amounts of electric damage will "shock" an enemy, causing them to damage themselves and nearby allies periodically for a duration.

 Regular elemental damage is blocked by resistances and reduced somewhat by armor.
 Status effect damage passes through armor, but is blocked by resistance.
 Shields still block all damage and status effects, but are reduced with each hit.
 Elemental damage types can stack onto the same impact.  So a bullet can do physical, fire, chem, and electric damage in one hit if all are applied to it.  The visuals should hint at this (multi-element attacks will have multiple colors).
 All damage boosts are now a percent based off the base weapon's damage.


Damage Numbers

 Better readability, optimized spawning, more interesting animation, now shows color of dominant damage type with each impact.
 There will be an option to disable these numbers in the future.


Other Polish

 Enemy death animations
 Titan dissolve VFX
 Calldowns are more responsive
 New armor visuals (Golem enemy and Raptid - more armored and shielded enemies coming soon)
 Shield Generator has VFX to show when it activates (each round)
 New music system (each level picks a "non-combat" track and sticks with it for a session.  It resumes playing after combat is finished.  Combat music is still different each wave.)
 Line of sight fixes for turrets and mechs
 Range indicators for support assets
 Various bug fixes

notes.title: Introducing Temporal Titans
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108428/5f38473ab421c269e8a1fbee3a977d98f0eac858.jpg

The Temporal Titans Store Page is now live.  

I'm working hard to wrap up the Demo and plan to launch it very soon.  If you have any questions or just want to chat about the game, feel free to drop your thoughts in the Steam Hub.

Overview

Temporal Titans is a Tower-Defense game with Time Travel.  Send mechs back to previous waves to prevent your defeat, and protect your salvage team from the monstrous Krell as you scavenge the ruins of a lost earth.  Rewind, rethink, and reclaim the future!

Key features
Send mechs back in time, creating duplicate defenders
Unique mid-combat mech actions (movement and combat abilities)
Mech upgrades and customization
Unique mech pilots
Upgradable turrets
Support turrets, drones, and more
Destructible environments
Dynamic battlefields with elevation, multiple paths, and more
